summary.text: Cang Xuan Zi is Heavenly Court's vast heaven vine, a legendary immemorial beast also called the tenth heaven of this world for the aperture-expanding vast heaven fruits she provides.

claims.text: Duke Long notes that Cang Xuan Zi did not join the battle when Longevity Heaven attacked, citing an agreement with Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable from when she joined Heavenly Court. Bing Sai Chuan names her as one of Heavenly Court’s three legendary immemorial beasts and identifies her as the vast heaven vine: it sprouts, blossoms, and bears fruit on a three-hundred-year cycle, and the vast heaven fruits expand a grotto-heaven’s sky, so the vine is also known as the tenth heaven of this world. Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable brought the vine in personally. She is a unique existence who need not follow orders and only has to provide a batch of vast heaven fruits every thousand years.
In battle she appears as a female immortal whose entire body is made of wood, wearing a green dress of vines, with a human face, trunk rings on tree-bark skin, and eyes clear as a tranquil lake.
When struck down, her body returns to its original form as a giant green vine that once held the sky like a heavenly pillar.

When Fang Yuan invades Heavenly Court, she reveals herself and blocks Myriad Year Flying Warship, saying she will stop him from destroying Heavenly Court. She uses a space path killer move that lengthens distance and stalls him only temporarily while fighting beside Duke Long.

She lays countless high-power space path traps across the battlefield, quietly forming them while floating in place. After a secret agreement with Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable three hundred thousand years earlier, she lived peacefully in Heavenly Court and rarely fought, but her legendary immemorial beast standing was earned before that peace. Her combat style keeps the habits of an immemorial desolate plant: she stays in one spot, attacks at long range, creates distance with space path methods, then lays traps. Fang Yuan’s time cutting edge strikes her forehead with dense time path dao marks that legendary immemorial beast recovery cannot regenerate; she falls, reverts to the giant green vine, and her aura cannot be detected.

With her vitality gone and her body lying dead, Heavenly Court loses the space path methods that had shortened and lengthened distance for defense. Sword waves cut the vast heaven vine while she does not wake; the text treats her as truly dead, with no vitality and a miserable vine body.
Fang Yuan notes that Heavenly Court’s aperture space is large enough for a huge qi harvest fruit because of Cang Xuan Zi’s space path fruits.
